title: Please please please make the mobile version more user-friendly
body:
I really love the desktop version, it’s help me a lot. But PLEASE PLEASE PLEASE update the mobile app it’s insufferable to use. I understand that it’s like an add-on to the desktop version, but at the moment the only thing that works in the mobile app is looking at your tasks. You can only look, cause if you god forbid try to change anything it either won’t work or it’ll destroy all your planning 🥲

I mean come on I pay real money just to have the app, I except the mobile version to get as much attention as the well-working desktop version
author: YllesCorner

title: Much improved mobile app!
body: Sunsama is excellent, the focus timer integrated into planning tools is what makes it so great. Hope you will soon also implement live activity and dynamic island integration, as the focus bar is a bit hidden in the app right now.
author: nielsiestrong

title: Great but expensive
body: Great app with a great philosophy but prohibitively expensive which takes away a star. If you’re fine with a premium price it’s really a great tool.
author: jhshda
